title: 💻 Mission 1 — Agent ID Generator
subtitle: Create a formatted Morpheus agent identification code.
instructions: Replace each "____" with the correct variable. The final result should use the format AGENT-[SECTOR]-[BADGE]: [NAME].
starterCode:
# AGENT ID GENERATOR - Morpheus Security Systems

name = input("Enter your full name: ")
badge = input("Enter your 3-digit badge number: ")
sector = input("Enter your sector (Alpha/Beta/Delta): ")

agent_id = "AGENT-" + "____" + "-" + "____" + ": " + "____"

print("=== MORPHEUS SECURITY SYSTEMS ===")
print("Agent ID:", "____")
print("Status: ACTIVE")
hints: The required order is sector, badge, then name.
Use the variable agent_id in the final print statement.
successMessage: Your code includes the required variables. Run it and check the Agent ID format.
